svg.aria-label: From a change to a release. make check: gofmt, vet, staticcheck, the race tests and shellcheck. make test-windows: every package again as a Windows program. CI: both, fuzzing, govulncheck and a real shrink on WSL 2. A vX.Y.Z tag: all of CI, then the zips, the Scoop manifest and the demo image.
